objective: Repeat R111's unchanged layer-0 MLP request-isolation treatment after registering the MLP itself in vLLM's static forward context.

single_change.remove: Parent-MLP attribute attached to the attention object after its static-context registration.
single_change.add: A unique static_forward_context entry for the layer-0 dense MLP, resolved directly from ForwardContext.no_compile_layers inside the custom op.

mandatory_gates.source: The semantic validator must require direct static-context registration and lookup, one live compiled call site, and reject R111/R112 lookup forms.
mandatory_gates.startup: Profile run must execute the single-request control and reach HTTP ready.
mandatory_gates.runtime_execution: Require both single-request-control and split-per-request markers.
mandatory_gates.identity: Warm c1 must be exact before any c2 result is interpreted; all outputs complete and cache-zero.
mandatory_gates.workload: One c1 and two c2 warm repeats, then three c1 and twenty c2 counted repeats.

decision.pass: Run the treatment factorial without inherited R108 projection tracing, then fresh-server realistic qualification on a clean boot.
decision.fail: Reject the treatment if startup or c1 fails; reject it as insufficient if repeated c2 identity fails.

resource_boundary: 12 GiB container RAM, 16 GiB RAM-plus-swap, no reboot or GPU reset.
reporting_boundary: Diagnostic only; no public speed or quality claim.
